notes: fishaudio/s1-mini (OpenAudio S1-mini, 0.5B) from the official gated repo, run through fish-speech pinned at commit 80db25e (the last one before the S2 rewrite). The shim encodes the reference clips once at start on the CPU, then decodes in bf16 so the model fits an 8 GB card shared with a desktop; the default fp32 codec ran out of memory. Output is 44.1 kHz. The maker's laughing and sighing markers are meant to be followed by an onomatopoeia (Ha,ha,ha), so the bare tag may be weak. Its (panting) marker is not mapped to breath. Needs HF_TOKEN at first start. One line took about 19 to 20 seconds on a 3060 Ti. GPU only: one CPU line took 154 s warm on a quiet box (16 cores, nothing else rendering, 2026-10-23).
